summary: DR-ROI-001E independent verification: 16/16 backend pytest cases pass against live preview URL, and all 3 SPA dashboards (/admin/ods-intelligence, /pm/operational-intelligence, /executive/ods-intelligence) render the required three horizons, evidence footer, real ODS KPI numbers (120 labor hrs, 32.5 equipment hrs, 2 photos, 3 projects reporting for this_week), attention items with severity chips + source_type + fact_id traceability, and empty-state messages for empty buckets. Zero AI-branding leaks in either DOM or JSON responses.

ui_bugs.issue: Preset button testids are rendered as `admin-intel-preset-picker-{key}` (compound: picker_testid + key) rather than the spec's `admin-intel-preset-{key}`. All 8 keys (today, yesterday, this_week, last_week, month, last_month, quarter, year) are present with the compound name. Same pattern applies to pm-intel-preset-picker-* and exec-intel-preset-picker-*. Buttons are clickable and functional.

action_items: OPTIONAL: If external QA scripts rely on the spec pattern `admin-intel-preset-{key}`, either update the spec to `admin-intel-preset-picker-{key}` or change PresetPicker to render `${testid.replace('-picker','')}-${p.key}` for the individual buttons. Not a functional bug.
critical_code_review_comments: PresetPicker testid pattern for individual buttons compounds picker's testid + key; docs/spec should reflect this or code should shorten to match spec.
All ODS intelligence endpoints returned within acceptable latency (~30s for full suite of 16 tests including 8 preset variants).
Response bodies confirmed free of forbidden AI-branding tokens; case-insensitive scan covers claude/anthropic/openai/gpt-/gemini/model:/provider:.
test_credentials: None used - anonymous access to /api/ods/* is functional in preview per problem statement; SPA routes rendered without login prompt.
seed_data_creation: None - relied on pre-existing ODS fixtures (24-115 project, 2026-07-05 daily_report_v2 facts).
context_for_next_testing_agent: Backend regression suite at /app/backend/tests/test_dr_roi_001e_review.py covers all 7 endpoints + 8 preset variants + AI-branding scan (16 tests, ~32s). Preset button testids on the SPA use pattern `{picker_testid}-{key}` e.g. `admin-intel-preset-picker-today`. All 3 dashboards confirmed live with real KPI data at preview URL.
